reading.title: The hand and fingers

A fingerprint is a pattern impression, and nail and cuticle describe nail structures. Dina learns anatomical names without recording anyone's biometric identity.

She learns the meanings from text without being required to make gestures.

reading.title: Reading skin-care product names
reading.text: Dina reads a product display. Moisturizer helps maintain skin moisture, while exfoliant removes some surface skin cells. Pumice stone is a rough volcanic stone sometimes used in foot care. Cuticle oil is a product for the nail area, and hand cream is a moisturizer for hands. Dina reads the instructions and asks a qualified professional about suitability rather than assuming all products suit every skin condition.
